newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy faring reasonably well -- Rubin.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy faring reasonably well -- Rubin.

text.p: Japan's economy is doing reasonably well and the the main issue for Japan is to maintain domestic demand-led growth, U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin told reporters on Friday.
"Japan's economy seems to be doing reasonably well and the issues really are continuing on the path of domestic demand-led growth," Rubin said when asked what problems were faced by Japan's economy.

Commenting on Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto's deregulation package Rubin said: "I think the prime minister has a very impressive programme with respect to deregulation. I think it is a kind of programme that offers a great deal to Japan over the long run.
